finding: Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument was registered on a session detached before reload. Native helper saw ReferenceError for passive observer after real reload.
fixScope: Only owned acceptance helper holds its CDP session through Page.reload and observer initialization; production unchanged.
productEvidence: fullscreen autoplay screenshot shows shared toolbar present; cancellation not yet verified
rootCause: A separate attached CDP session must enable Page before registering the new-document script. The setup now explicitly enables Page, waits for a changed performance.timeOrigin and observer in the reloaded document, then detaches.
